# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-15

This release completes touchscreen navigation across the custom library and reading-statistics screens, with dedicated firmware images for Xteink X4 and X4 Pro.

## Fixed

- Added touch selection to the book actions menu.
- Added row taps and swipe pagination to Deferred Books.
- Added touch selection and swipe pagination to library filters and sorting.
- Added touch access to library filters from the library header.
- Added tap-to-close behavior to the full-size book cover view.
- Fixed the touch back action on the global reading-statistics screen.

## Notes

- Xteink X4 Pro users must install `firmware-x4pro.bin`.
- Xteink X4 users must continue to use `firmware.bin`.
- Firmware images contain a board identifier and reject installation on a different supported board.
